Hi list,


I'm puzzled by this (new) behaviour,

load("test.rda")

p1<-
ggplot(data = md, mapping = aes(x = date,y = value)) +
facet_wrap(~key,ncol=1, scale="free_y") +
layer(colour="grey30",fill="grey", geom = c( "histogram"), size=0.2,
stat = "identity" ) +
geom_blank(data=ylims, mapping=aes(y=lims))


p1 +
scale_y_continuous("number of publications", expand=c(0, 0)) +
scale_x_date("year")
